item.text: {"slug":"census-asec-direct-purchase-coverage-rate-2025","country":"US","type":"data","title":"US direct-purchase coverage rate 2025","question":"U.S. Census Bureau CPS ASEC direct-purchase health insurance coverage rate for all persons, calendar year 2025, first print in the Health Insurance Coverage in the United States release, percent of people covered for all or part of the year.","unit":"percent","pointEstimate":11.3,"ciLow":10.7,"ciHigh":11.9,"confidence":0.8,"resolutionDate":"2026-09-08","resolutionSource":"U.S. Census Bureau, Health Insurance Coverage in the United States: 2025 and HHI-01 CPS historical table","resolutionSourceUrl":"https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/demo/tables/health-insurance/time-series/hic/hhi01.xlsx","resolutionRule":"Resolve to the first U.S. Census Bureau CPS ASEC national all-persons direct-purchase health insurance coverage percentage for calendar year 2025, as first printed in Health Insurance Coverage in the United States: 2025 or its linked HHI-01 table. Use the HHI-01 all-persons direct-purchase coverage percentage rounded to one decimal place; ignore later revisions, errata, vintage population-control updates, ACS estimates, FRED mirrors, and derived recalculations.","dataPointId":"census.cps_asec.hhi01.direct_purchase_coverage_rate.2025.first_print","historicalContext":[{"label":"2022 CPS ASEC HHI-01 direct-purchase coverage rate","value":9.9},{"label":"2023 CPS ASEC HHI-01 direct-purchase coverage rate","value":10.2},{"label":"2024 CPS ASEC HHI-01 direct-purchase coverage rate","value":10.8},{"label":"2025 marketplace plan selections","value":24.3}],"drivers":["ACA marketplace enrollment rose into the 2025 coverage year","Enhanced premium tax credits remained in effect during 2025","Medicaid unwinding transition effects still support nongroup take-up","Direct-purchase CPS category includes but is broader than ACA marketplace coverage","Employer coverage and public coverage changes can offset direct-purchase gains"],"sourceContext":["https://www.census.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2026/income-poverty-schedule.html","https://www.census.gov/newsroom/press-kits/2025/income-poverty-health-insurance.html","https://www.census.gov/data/tables/time-series/demo/health-insurance/historical-series/hic.html","https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/demo/tables/health-insurance/time-series/hic/hhi01.xlsx","https://www.cms.gov/newsroom/press-releases/over-24-million-consumers-selected-affordable-health-coverage-aca-marketplace-2025-open-enrollment"],"runAt":"2026-06-27T13:46:36Z","reasoning":[{"kind":"heading","text":"Forecast for 2025 CPS ASEC direct-purchase health insurance coverage"},{"kind":"text","text":"The resolver is the U.S. Census Bureau CPS ASEC first print for calendar-year 2025 direct-purchase health insurance coverage among all persons, reported as a percent. This is an annual coverage-for-all-or-part-of-year concept, not an end-of-year enrollment count."},{"kind":"tool","tool":"official.lookup","call":"Checked Census 2026 income, poverty, and health insurance schedule page for the official release date.","result":"Fetched official schedule giving Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 10:00 EDT for the 2025 income, poverty, and health insurance statistics release; numeric values fetched: 2025, 2026-09-08, 10:00 EDT."},{"kind":"tool","tool":"official.lookup","call":"Checked Census 2025 press kit for the prior first-print release page and linked health insurance report/tables.","result":"Fetched press kit dated September 09, 2025, listing Health Insurance Coverage in the United States: 2024 and linked Health Insurance Data Tables; numeric values fetched: 2024 and 2025-09-09."},{"kind":"tool","tool":"official.lookup","call":"Checked Census HHI historical tables page for the relevant CPS ASEC data source and time-series scope.","result":"Fetched HHI CPS table page stating CPS ASEC HHI series provides estimates from 2017 to 2024 and linking HHI-01; numeric range fetched: 2017-2024."},{"kind":"tool","tool":"official.lookup","call":"Used Census HHI-01 recent first-print-style reference values for all-persons direct-purchase coverage rate.","result":"Fetched recent all-persons direct-purchase coverage rates: 2022 9.9 percent, 2023 10.2 percent, 2024 10.8 percent."},{"kind":"tool","tool":"official.lookup","call":"Checked CMS ACA Marketplace 2025 open-enrollment public figure as a policy-mechanism input for nongroup coverage.","result":"Fetched CMS marketplace plan selection count of 24.3 million for 2025 coverage, compared with about 21.4 million for 2024 coverage."},{"kind":"text","text":"Base-rate/reference-class anchor: the recent CPS ASEC direct-purchase rate moved 9.9 to 10.2 to 10.8, a three-year level near 10.3 percent and recent annual changes of +0.3 and +0.6 percentage point. A neutral continuation anchor is roughly 11.1 percent before current-year policy adjustment."},{"kind":"text","text":"Level and momentum: the 2024 level already incorporated part of Medicaid unwinding and marketplace growth. Momentum into 2025 remains positive because marketplace selections rose again, but CPS annual coverage will translate enrollment into the all-person annual coverage category imperfectly."},{"kind":"text","text":"One-off and policy mechanisms: enhanced ACA subsidies were still active for 2025 and should keep direct-purchase take-up elevated. Some Medicaid unwinding transition into marketplace coverage likely persists, but the largest unwinding shock was earlier, so I do not project another 0.6 point jump."},{"kind":"text","text":"Counter-consideration: CPS classification noise, off-exchange attrition, employer/public coverage substitution, and churn can cause marketplace growth to show less strongly in the direct-purchase all-person annual rate; a flat 10.8 to 11.0 print is plausible if selection counts overstate sustained coverage."},{"kind":"math","text":"Base 2024 rate 10.8 + expected 2025 net increase 0.5 = 11.3. The 80 percent interval is judgmental rather than a clean long-history volatility estimate: recent annual changes of +0.3 and +0.6, survey/category noise, and policy churn support a +/-0.6 point band, giving 10.7 to 11.9."},{"kind":"text","text":"Upside scenario: marketplace enrollment persistence and continued subsidy take-up push direct-purchase coverage above 11.9 percent. Downside scenario: churn, Medicaid/public coverage retention, or CPS classification effects keep the rate near 10.7 percent or below. Outside-interval downside would require little translation from the 24.3 million marketplace selections into annual CPS coverage."},{"kind":"text","text":"Review disposition: accepted the resolver critique by grounding September 8, 2026 in the official Census 2026 schedule and distinguishing the timing URL from the HHI-01 resolving table; accepted the interval critique by labeling the +/-0.6 band as judgmental 80 percent uncertainty rather than a precise long-history volatility estimate; retained the central forecast because the source evidence and mechanism balance did not change."},{"kind":"forecast","point":11.3,"ciLow":10.7,"ciHigh":11.9}]}
